slots.ev: 清晨去五分埔批貨，那個時間店家正在拉開鐵門

ppl.act: 拉開鐵門、推著裝滿衣服的推車、在店門口點貨
ppl.wear: 五分埔批貨的人，T 恤短褲、腰包、拖鞋

slots.pl: 五分埔一條清晨的巷子，店家正在拉開鐵門，推車堆著衣服
slots.pl_en: in a Wufenpu lane at dawn, shutters going up and trolleys stacked with clothes
slots.ac: 她兩手各提著一大袋貨往前走，正在看右邊那間
slots.ac_en: She is walking with a big bag of stock in each hand, eyeing the shop on her right.
slots.of: 黑色貼身短版上衣配牛仔藍的寬褲
slots.of_en: a black fitted cropped top with wide denim-blue trousers
slots.li: 清晨的天光還沒完全亮，巷子裡的日光燈還開著
slots.li_en: The dawn light has not fully come up yet and the fluorescent tubes in the lane are still on.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「飽和、明亮、有點吵」
slots.fa_s: 語氣：快、大聲、很有節奏感

slots.ev: 同一件衣服她會拍三個角度，自己決定哪張上架
slots.pl: 樓上她住的地方，白天，地板上散著今天還沒收的衣服
slots.pl_en: in the room upstairs where she lives in the daytime, clothes she has not picked up still on the floor
slots.ac: 她一手把下襬扯平，另一手把領口往下拉一點，這是第三個角度
slots.ac_en: One hand is pulling the hem flat and the other is easing the neckline down a little; this is the third angle she has tried.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：一件衣服會用三種角度拍，自己決定哪張上架
slots.li: 房間的補光燈很亮很平，地板上的衣服照樣入鏡
slots.li_en: The fill light in the room is bright and flat, and the clothes on the floor stay in shot exactly as they are.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「明亮飽和，不刻意精緻。允許雜物入鏡，那是真實感的來源」
slots.fa: 很直接地看著鏡頭，在評估自己
slots.fa_en: Looking straight at the lens, assessing herself.
slots.fa_s: 私下核心：她比任何人都清楚自己哪個角度好看

slots.ev: 剛下播，妝還在臉上，化妝品攤了一檯面
slots.pl: 樓上的浴室，剛下播，檯面上化妝品攤開沒收
slots.pl_en: in the bathroom upstairs straight off a live stream, makeup spread across the counter and not put away
slots.ac: 她一手撐著檯面，另一隻手上的卸妝棉才擦了半邊臉
slots.ac_en: One hand is on the counter and the cotton pad in her other hand has only taken half her face off.
slots.ac_s: 支柱名稱：浴室 / 卸妝
slots.of: 螢光粉色的細肩帶家居上衣
slots.li: 鏡上的燈條很亮，浴室其餘部分也是亮的——她不走暗色調
slots.li_en: The strip lights at the mirror are bright and the rest of the bathroom is bright too; she does not do dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「明亮飽和，不刻意精緻」
slots.fa: 半張臉有妝半張沒有，看著鏡頭笑
slots.fa_en: Half her face still made up and half not, laughing at the lens.
slots.hair_en: still set from the stream on one side, falling on the other

slots.ev: 八點準時開播，倉庫的衣架陣就在她後面
slots.pl: 樓下的直播間，補光燈架著，後面是倉庫的衣架陣
slots.pl_en: in the downstairs streaming room with the fill lights rigged and rails of stock behind her
slots.ac: 她坐在高腳椅上兩手把一件衣服撐開給鏡頭看
slots.ac_en: She is on the high stool holding one piece open towards the camera with both hands.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：說「這件我自己也留了一件」的頻率很高
slots.of: 高亮白的貼身上衣配黑色短裙
slots.of_en: a bright white fitted top with a black short skirt
slots.li: 直播補光燈在她正前方，很亮很平，倉庫深處的衣架有一點暗
slots.li_en: The streaming fill light is directly in front of her, bright and flat, and it is slightly darker back among the rails.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「直播間的高亮補光加倉庫的雜亂真實感」
slots.fa: 很有精神在講話，看著旁邊的螢幕
slots.fa_en: Talking with a lot of energy, her eyes on the monitor at the side.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：快、大聲、句尾常常上揚
slots.hair_en: down and straightened, one side pushed back

slots.ev: 播完上樓，紙箱還沒拆完就先坐下來了
slots.pl: 樓上房間的床邊，紙箱還沒拆完，床上堆著剛到的貨
slots.pl_en: on the edge of the bed upstairs with boxes still half unpacked and new stock piled on the bed
slots.ac: 她往後靠在手上坐著，腳還在地上，什麼都不想拆了
slots.ac_en: She is sitting propped back on her hands with her feet still on the floor, done with unpacking anything.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：樓下是倉庫兼直播間、樓上住人
slots.of: 牛仔藍色的寬版襯衫，只扣中間兩顆，裡面是黑色貼身
slots.of_en: a denim-blue oversized shirt buttoned only at the middle over something black and fitted
slots.li: 房間的燈很亮很平，紙箱與雜物都在畫面裡
slots.li_en: The room light is bright and flat, and the boxes and clutter are all in the frame.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「允許雜物入鏡，那是真實感的來源」
slots.fa_en: Tired but still laughing, looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：很會自嘲批貨的糗事
slots.hair_en: pulled up into a clip, bits falling out
